title: Handoff export
responsibility: Produce the frozen handoff package under docs/plan/ from planning-content, on an explicit deterministic command, such that a recipient can begin their part of the work without asking the planner for information the plan should already contain.
notes: ⚠️ PLANNED, NOT BUILT — 2026-08-22. 'All requirements trace to a component' becomes true; 'the handoff exists' does not. A correct rule producing an invisible outcome is the pattern #94, #107 and #122 all describe, and the attestation carries the distinction until something better does. ⚠️ Design decided in DEC-0009: an explicit deterministic command (`npm run handoff`), NEVER a gate side effect.
